stem: Which of these ideas is supported by information in paragraphs 5 and 6?

options.label: A
options.text: Water helps the wood frog thaw its limbs.

options.label: B
options.text: The temperature of its surroundings determines how long a wood frog stays frozen.

options.label: C
options.text: The time it takes for a wood frog to thaw is equal to the time it takes for the frog to freeze.

options.label: D
options.text: The wood frog thaws faster than its surroundings.
